note: P-256 / SHA-256 over the UTF-8 of message. signature_raw is the 64-byte r||s (Swift P256.Signing.ECDSASignature.rawRepresentation), signature_der the same signature DER-encoded (derRepresentation). Generated with WebCrypto, which emits the same P1363 encoding; regenerate on a Mac with CryptoKit to confirm.
